prompt: Why does the staff search tool keep old part names?
promptZh: 為何員工搜尋工具保留舊零件名稱？

options.text: To help technicians use older repair notes to find current replacements.
options.zh: 讓技術員能依舊維修紀錄找到替換品。
options.whyZh: 搜尋別名的目的就是讓舊稱仍可連到正確現行備品。

options.text: To print both names on every service list.
options.zh: 在每份印刷清單上同時列出新舊名稱。
options.whyZh: 印刷清單上只顯示新名稱。

options.text: To let technicians bill for discontinued parts.
options.zh: 讓技術員能開立停供零件的發票。
options.whyZh: 停供零件要另記，不用別名開票。

options.text: To select one default handle for every search.
options.zh: 替每次搜尋選定一種預設把手。
options.whyZh: 若對應兩種，須顯示兩筆，不設預設。

explanationZh: 搜尋別名的目的就是讓舊稱仍可連到正確現行備品。
evidence: Keep each old name as a search alias in the staff tool so a technician reading an old repair note can still find the right replacement.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Keep each old name as a search alias in the staff tool so a technician reading an old repair note can still find the right replacement.

vocabulary.note: 用舊名稱也能找到以新名稱登記的品項。
